faq.question: Q1. What is the SDAU Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Krishi Vigyan Kendra, S. D. Agricultural University, Deesa, to engage one Young Professional-II under the NICRA project through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for SDAU Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-II post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the SDAU Young Professional-II walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 27/10/2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the office of the Director of Extension Education, S. D. Agricultural University, Sardarkrushinagar, Dist: Banaskantha.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for SDAU Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. (Agri.) in Agronomy, Horticulture, Agriculture Extension, or Agriculture Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 45 years on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for SDAU Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed contractual pay of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the outsourcing engagement is purely on a temporary and adhoc basis for 11 months or till the completion of the project, whichever comes first.
